title: Directors' resolution in writing
summary: The directors allot shares under the members' approval, and authorise the lodgement with ACRA.

fields.name: members_approved_on
fields.label: The day the members approved the issue

fields.name: allottee
fields.label: Whom the shares are allotted to

paragraphs: We, being all the directors of {{.Company.Name}}, pass the following resolutions in writing, as the company's constitution allows.
The members approved the issue of shares on {{.F.members_approved_on}}, under section 161 of the Companies Act 1967.

sections.heading: Resolved
items: That {{.F.shares}} {{.F.share_class}} shares in the company be allotted and issued to {{.F.allottee}} at {{.F.price}} each, fully paid.
That any one director or the secretary be authorised to lodge the allotment with ACRA and to update the company's records.
